grade.name: Form 1
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 1" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

topics.name: Topic 5: Mechanics 1
topics.description: Mechanics is a branch of physics that deals with the study of motion, forces, and energy. It involves understanding how objects move, respond to forces, and interact with their environment.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1: Forces
sub_topics.description: A force is a push or pull that causes an object to change its state of motion, speed, direction, or shape.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 4: Circular Motion
sub_topics.description: Circular motion is the motion of an object in a circular path, where the direction of the velocity is constantly changing.

competencies.description: Apply circular motion concepts to solve problems and make predictions

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 5: Moment of a Force
sub_topics.description: Moment of a force is the turning effect of force and it is equal to the product of force and perpendicular distance from the line of action of force to the pivot.

competencies.description: Create a tool that applies moment of a force in solving problems in everyday life.
